Read exactly one tool-segmented row of a scientific heatmap. The full matrix has 7 rows and 19 columns; this atlas is row 0.
Each tile is an independent cell and is labelled CELL C00 through CELL C18. Inspect only the pixels inside the tile with that label. Do not move values between cells. Do not infer numbers from colour.

Use token_type: printed_integer for a complete visible integer; dash for a visible dash; missing for an explicit missing/not-tested marker; no_printed_number when no number is printed; unreadable when text may exist but cannot be read reliably. Only printed_integer may have an integer value_numeric. All other value_numeric fields must be null.
